_comment: The region register (#19 §2, #40). Every difference normalization does not claim must be claimed
here, by a pattern carrying a written reason — plus a ticket where the difference is a known bug.
known-divergence  carries a reason and a ticket
An empty region fails as stale, so an entry bites the run after its cause is fixed rather than
rotting silently. `compare.mjs --record` refreshes the recorded values of a region whose content
moved, and stamps it with the baseline it was affirmed against — it cannot create a region.
Claiming a new class of difference is a reviewed change to this file.
Empty until the net captures its first traces (#51).
